outputs.reason: The manuscript includes the exact TargetScan URL (https://www.targetscan.org/vert_80/). Domain and path match the TargetScan vertebrate v8.0 resource and the URL is well-formed and consistent with how the authors state they used TargetScan for miRNA target prediction.

The manuscript states 'RNA-seq data have been deposited in the BioStudies database under accession number S-BSST2081' but does not provide an explicit URL. The accession string is provided and appears syntactically plausible as a BioStudies accession, but I cannot verify that this identifier resolves to a public record or that the record contains the described RNA-seq data without checking the repository (no web access performed).
